formulaBlock.normalization: AQUA / WATER, CI 60730 / EXT. VIOLET 2 and PARFUM / FRAGRANCE one entry each; normalized one-based positions.
formulaBlock.e3ProminenceCutoff: PARFUM / FRAGRANCE listed last (27) -> positions 1-26 mechanically prominent (atypical ordering; recorded)

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) with prominent buffers Cocamidopropyl Betaine (5) and Coco-Betaine (10); no reinforcing strong anionic -> moderate.
cleansingStrength.counterSignals: Cocamide MEA (9) is a foam booster (not a route); Trideceth-10/-3 are emulsifiers.

conditioningLevel.rationale: C2 met: early silicone Dimethicone (6), cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (8), pearlizing route Glycol Distearate (3), humectant Sodium Hyaluronate (13) as its own entry; plus late Amodimethicone (23). Multiple complementary systems.
conditioningLevel.counterSignals: The humectant element rests only on Sodium Hyaluronate (trace in practice).

weightPotential.rationale: W1 applies: (a) C1 sulfate chassis with prominent buffers, cleansing moderate; (b) deposition evidence is exactly silicone (Dimethicone 6) + cationic guar (8) + late Amodimethicone (23); (c) no further persistent family converges (no prominent payload lipid, no second cationic, no film former, no protein) and no W-RICH -> moderate.

depositionLoad.rationale: Early dimethicone + guar coacervate + late amodimethicone.

excluded: Steareth-6 (14), PEG-100 Stearate (17), Trideceth-10 (18), Trideceth-3 (19): emulsifiers for the silicone
Salicylic Acid (20), Acetic Acid (16), Fumaric Acid (22), Citric Acid (25): acids/pH
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Settled W1 set within its conditions: silicone/guar/late-amodimethicone on an effective sulfate base is moderate.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W1 conditions all hold - no W-RICH, no extra converging persistent family, effective C1 reset. Not low: an early silicone with a cationic deposition polymer is a plausibly persistent system.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Dimethicone is very early (6, before the guar); realistic unknowns could push toward high.

focusPrimary.rationale: Formula-only: generic silicone/guar conditioning (nonspecific); violet colorant suggests a toning/colour role, which is not a focus value; shine plausible if positioned (silicone film, acids).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Positioning unknown. CSA formula half met only mechanically: Sodium Hyaluronate (13) on the E4 humectant list is prominent because Parfum is listed last.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole; Salicylic Acid (20) does not count (Section 11).
